working_definition_ja: 賭けの価格・払戻倍率等を表す数値。
notes: P0-SRC-042 verifies odds as a payout-rate/multiple concept in JRA; representation conventions vary by jurisdiction and betting system.

working_definition_ja: 購入時等に払戻条件が固定される賭け方式。
notes: P0-SRC-043 explicitly describes bookmaker settlement at the odds agreed when the bet is purchased; regulatory implementations vary.

preferred_ja: パリミュチュエル方式
working_definition_ja: 賭金をプールし控除後の金額を的中者間で分配する方式。
notes: P0-SRC-043 explicitly contrasts pari-mutuel with bookmaking; P0-SRC-041 corroborates pool-based JRA payout calculations.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国・アイルランド等で、プール方式の馬券またはその運営システム・運営主体を指す語。地域・事業者により意味範囲が異なる。
notes: P0-SRC-070 verifies Tote as pool-based wagering distinct from bookmaker fixed odds; retain operator/system-sensitive scope rather than treating Tote as a universal synonym for pari-mutuel.

working_definition_ja: 投票集計・払戻計算を行うシステム、またはその方式。
notes: Current authority material shows totalisator usage but does not yet cleanly resolve the seed's system-versus-method polysemy.

working_definition_ja: 同一賭式について参加者の賭金をまとめ、控除後の金額を的中者へ分配するための賭金集合。
notes: PB-SRC-005;PB-SRC-006 directly explain pooled wagering and distribution mechanics; pool definitions and deductions remain operator/jurisdiction specific.

working_definition_ja: パリミュチュエル等の投票プールから払戻計算前に控除される割合。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines NYRA takeout rates from wagering pools; taxes and statutory allocation of deductions vary by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: プール方式の賭けで的中した単位賭金に対して公表される払戻額・配当。
notes: PB-SRC-005;PB-SRC-007;PB-SRC-009 support Dividend as a payout/result of pool betting; display bases and deductions vary.

working_definition_ja: 的中した賭けに対して支払われる金額。
notes: P0-SRC-041 provides authority payout rules and calculations; taxes, deductions and settlement details remain jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 1着馬を当てる賭式。
notes: P0-SRC-040 verifies JRA 単勝 as selecting the horse that finishes first; local naming and bet availability vary.

working_definition_ja: 一定着順以内を対象とする賭式。具体的条件は地域で異なる。
notes: P0-SRC-040 verifies a place-type bet and explicitly shows the qualifying placing range can depend on field size; do not universalize JRA thresholds.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で、選んだ馬が3着以内など所定の上位着順に入ることを条件とする賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines NYRA Show wagering as the selected horse finishing first, second or third.

working_definition_ja: 同一選択についてWinとPlaceの二つの賭けを組み合わせる方式。Place条件は競走・事業者で異なる。
notes: PB-SRC-005;PB-SRC-009 directly support Each-Way as combined Win and Place wagering; place terms remain local.

working_definition_ja: 1着・2着となる2頭を着順を問わず当てる賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006;PB-SRC-007;PB-SRC-008 verify the first-two-in-any-order mechanic. Reverse Forecast/Dual Forecast regional labels are modeled through the label/disposition layer rather than duplicate Concepts.

working_definition_ja: 1着・2着となる2頭を正しい着順で当てる賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006;PB-SRC-008;PB-SRC-009 verify exact first-two order. Straight Forecast is preserved as a regional label; generic Forecast is not treated as globally unambiguous.

working_definition_ja: 1着・2着・3着となる3頭を正しい着順で当てる賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006;PB-SRC-008 verify exact first-three order. Tricast/Tierce regional labels are preserved without retaining duplicate Concepts.

working_definition_ja: 1着・2着・3着となる3頭を着順を問わず当てる賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-007 directly defines HKJC Trio as selecting the first three finishers in any order; keep regional scope.

working_definition_ja: 1着から4着までの4頭を正しい着順で当てる賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines NYRA Superfecta as selecting the first four finishers in exact order.

working_definition_ja: 指定された2競走の勝馬をともに当てる複数競走賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines the Daily Double as selecting the winners of two designated races; scheduling details vary.

working_definition_ja: 指定された3競走の勝馬をすべて当てる複数競走賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines Pick 3 as selecting winners of three consecutive/designated races in NYRA wagering.

working_definition_ja: 指定された4競走の勝馬をすべて当てる複数競走賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines Pick 4 in current NYRA wagering.

working_definition_ja: 指定された5競走の勝馬をすべて当てる複数競走賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines Pick 5 in current NYRA wagering.

working_definition_ja: 指定された6競走の勝馬をすべて当てる複数競走賭式。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines Pick 6 in current NYRA wagering.

working_definition_ja: 主に英国・アイルランド等で、発走時に確定する公式の開始価格・最終オッズを指す語。
notes: P0-SRC-071 verifies Starting Price as the final odds prevailing when the race starts. SP is retained as an abbreviation label via ABBR-027; former duplicate Concept BET-028 is merged into BET-027.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で、発走前に作成・公表される予想オッズ。最終的な実投票オッズそのものではない。
notes: PB-SRC-011 explains the morning line as advance predicted odds; PB-SRC-012 confirms current NYRA use of a morning-line oddsmaker.

working_definition_ja: 最も支持されている馬。英米で綴り差がある。
notes: P0-SRC-044 verifies favorite as 一番人気馬 in JRA official overseas terminology; Favorite/Favourite spelling split remains in the label layer.

working_definition_ja: 勝つ可能性が低いと市場で評価され、比較的高いオッズが付いている馬を指す競馬・馬券用語。
notes: PB-SRC-009;PB-SRC-010 support current racing-betting use of Longshot for a horse at long odds; exact odds thresholds are not canonicalized.

working_definition_ja: 市場で勝つ可能性が低いと評価され、比較的高いオッズとなっている馬。
notes: PB-SRC-009;PB-SRC-010 support Outsider as a horse not strongly fancied in the betting market; keep usage scope-sensitive.

working_definition_ja: 利益部分が賭金より小さくなる水準、すなわちEvensより短いオッズを指す表現。
notes: PB-SRC-009;PB-SRC-010 directly support Odds-on as shorter than evens / risking more than the potential profit.

working_definition_ja: 利益額と賭金額が同額となる1対1相当のオッズ表現。
notes: PB-SRC-009;PB-SRC-010 define Evens as the even-money/1-to-1 betting price.

working_definition_ja: 単位賭金に対する元本込みの総払戻額を十進数の倍率で表すオッズ形式。
notes: PB-SRC-009 defines decimal odds as a return multiplier including stake; usage is wider than racing but is established in racing betting.

working_definition_ja: 利益と賭金の比を分数で表すオッズ形式。
notes: Current racing authority material uses fractional presentation, but this seed still lacks a sufficiently direct standalone definition for promotion.

working_definition_ja: 正負の数値で利益・必要賭金を表すオッズ形式。
notes: Common sportsbook terminology, but a sufficiently strong current horse-racing authority source has not yet been established.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で上位着順圏を指す競馬・馬券用語。
notes: Meaning is plausible and historically attested, but current authority evidence is insufficient for this pass.

working_definition_ja: 主に北米で、同一馬にWin・Place・Showの3つの賭けを同額等で同時に行う買い方。
notes: PB-SRC-006 directly defines Across the Board as three separate Win, Place and Show wagers on the same horse.
